lines.en: label yasudorm30:
I knock on Yasu’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Yasu 的门，等她来应。

lines.en: But given that this room also belongs to someone who is more socially competent {i}and{/i} not busy staring at a wall, I think it’s safe to assume her roommate will be answering instead.
lines.zh: 不过考虑到这间屋{i}也{/i}属于某个社交能力更正常、也没在忙着盯墙的人，我想基本可以假定是她室友来开门。

lines.en: : The door is open, Sensei. Come in.
lines.zh: : 门开着，老师。进来吧。

lines.en: scene black
My assumptions are proven correct for the umpteenth time — and now comes the part of the night where I have to explain to Touka that I’m not actually here to see {i}her,{/i} but her friend.
lines.zh: 我的推测第无数次被证实——现在到了今晚我得向 Touka 解释的环节：我不是来找{i}她{/i}的，是来找她朋友的。

lines.en: Though, I do worry just how much she’s heard about one of our more recent encounters.
lines.zh: 不过，我确实有点担心我们最近那次遭遇，她到底听说了多少。

lines.en: scene yasuflashback1
: Good evening, Sensei. And sincerest apologies if you are not in the mood to be confronted, but I have a bone to pick with you.
lines.zh: : 晚上好，老师。如果你没心情被质问，我先诚挚道歉。不过我有点事要跟你算账。

lines.en: : Can the bone be my penis? Because I’m never in the mood to be confronted, but am willing to make an exception so long as it’s that one.
lines.zh: : 那根骨头可以是我的阴茎吗？因为我从来没心情被质问，不过只要是那根，我愿意破个例。

lines.en: : You do realize there are no actual bones in that part of your body, correct?
lines.zh: : 你知道你身体那个部位其实没有骨头吧？

lines.en: : I do, Touka.
lines.zh: : 我知道，Touka。

lines.en: : Are you absolutely sure? Because there are many things you have both said and done in the brief time we’ve known each other that have led me to believe you’ve never received {i}any{/i} formal education whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 你真的确定？因为在我们相识的这短短时间里，你说过和做过的许多事，都让我相信你从没受过{i}任何{/i}正规教育。

lines.en: : Like that time you took poor Yasu out in the middle of the night to {i}God knows where{/i} and she came back a blubbering, shameful mess.
lines.zh: : 比如那次你半夜把可怜的 Yasu 带出去，{i}天知道{/i}去了哪儿，结果她回来时哭成一团、丢人现眼。

lines.en: : Yup, here we go. I was right to worry.
lines.zh: : 对，来了。我刚才的担心是对的。

lines.en: scene yasuflashback2
: What were you thinking? Why would you even {i}contemplate{/i} doing such a thing when you are {i}fully{/i} aware that Yasu requires...special attention?
lines.zh: : 你当时在想什么？你{i}明明{/i}清楚 Yasu 需要……特殊的照顾，怎么还会{i}考虑{/i}干这种事？

lines.en: : Let me just put my foot down now and say that wasn’t my idea at all. In fact, I’m pretty sure {i}neither{/i} of us wanted to go as far out as we did. But that’s what happened and I’m willing to take responsibility for it.
lines.zh: : 我先一句话摆在这儿：那根本不是我的主意。事实上，我敢说我俩{i}谁都没{/i}打算搞到那么远的地步。可事情就是发生了，而我愿意为此负责。

lines.en: : Don’t you go trying to talk your way out of-
lines.zh: : 你别想用嘴皮子糊弄过去——

lines.en: scene yasuflashback3
: Wait one moment. Did I hear that correctly? You are...{i}actually{/i} going to take responsibility for this? You’re not just fooling around with me again?
lines.zh: : 等等。我没听错吧？你……{i}真的{/i}要为此负责？你不是又在耍我？

lines.en: : Yes, but only because I think there’s something weird going on with Yasu and I’d rather talk about {i}that{/i} than the main reason you’re likely concerned about all of this.
lines.zh: : 是的，不过只是因为我觉得 Yasu 身上有点不对劲，而我更想谈{i}这个{/i}，而不是你大概真正担心的那件事。

lines.en: : Of course there is something weird going on with Yasu. She is a weird girl. Everything she {i}does{/i} is weird.
lines.zh: : Yasu 身上当然有点不对劲。她是个怪女孩。她{i}做{/i}的每件事都怪。

lines.en: scene yasuflashback4
: Just look at her- off in her own world and completely unaware that we’re even discussing her. That’s no fault of her own, though. I’ve realized by now that it’s simply the way she is.
lines.zh: : 就看看她——在自己的世界里，完全没意识到我们正在讨论她。不过那不是她的错。我早就明白，她本来就是那样。

lines.en: : Yeah, sure, but...do you ever think there might be more to it than that? That she isn’t just...abnormal or whatever, but...that there might be some element of truth to all the crazy things she says?
lines.zh: : 是，当然，可是……你有没有想过，背后也许不止这些？她不只是……不正常什么的，而是……她说的那些疯话里可能真有几分是真的？

lines.en: scene yasuflashback5
: I suppose so. But, concerning that aspect of her personality, however major it may be...I don’t think I’d put her on a level much different from any other fanatic.
lines.zh: : 我想是的。不过，关于她性格的那一面，不管它有多大……我不觉得我会把她放到跟别的狂信徒有多大差别的层面上。

lines.en: : There are elements of truth to all forms of spirituality, and it’s not uncommon for multiple schools of belief to follow the same tenets while dressed up in different clothing.
lines.zh: : 各种形式的灵性里都有真实的成分，而多个信仰流派遵循同样的信条、只是穿着不同的外衣，这并不罕见。

lines.en: : That’s not what I mean. Though, I will commend you on that surprisingly mature outlook.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。不过，你那份意外成熟的看法我得夸一句。

lines.en: scene yasuflashback6
: It’s to be expected. I’m a surprisingly mature young woman after all.
lines.zh: : 那是理所当然的。毕竟我是个意外成熟的年轻女性。

lines.en: : Please don’t say things that you know are going to give me ideas.
lines.zh: : 请别说那种你知道会让我起念头的话。

lines.en: : I see no harm in saying such things when those are ideas you already have in the first place.
lines.zh: : 既然那些念头你本来就有，我觉得说出来也没什么害处。

lines.en: : {i}Anyway...{/i}what I meant is that being around Yasu has been affecting {i}me{/i} lately. In ways much different than just getting annoyed by her endless spiritual rambling.
lines.zh: : {i}总之……{/i}我的意思是，最近待在 Yasu 身边一直在影响{i}我{/i}。而且不只是被她没完没了地念叨灵性玩意儿惹烦那么简单。

lines.en: scene yasuflashback7
: Affecting you {i}how?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}怎么{/i}影响你？

lines.en: : It’s hard to say. Just...
lines.zh: : 很难说。只是……

lines.en: : Between predicting the future and...knowing things she’s not supposed to know about me, it’s like she’s getting into my head. In a way that nobody else really has before.
lines.zh: : 从预言未来，到……知道一些她本不该知道的关于我的事，简直像她在钻进我的脑子。以前没有别人做到过这种程度。

lines.en: : I’m not quite sure I follow...
lines.zh: : 我不太确定我听懂了……

lines.en: : I’ve been...{i}seeing{/i} things when I’m with her.
lines.zh: : 我跟她在一起的时候……一直在{i}看见{/i}一些东西。

lines.en: : Things that...might be real or...might {i}not{/i} be real. And at other times, it feels like something might be speaking {i}through{/i} her. Do you know what I’m talking about?
lines.zh: : 那些东西……也许是真的，也许……{i}不是{/i}真的。而另一些时候，感觉像有什么东西在{i}借{/i}她的嘴说话。你明白我在说什么吗？

lines.en: : To be frank...no. I haven’t experienced anything like that with Yasu. Though, I {i}can{/i} see why that would be alarming.
lines.zh: : 坦白说……不明白。我跟 Yasu 从没经历过那种事。不过我{i}能{/i}理解为什么那会让人不安。

lines.en: : What is this about predicting the future, though?
lines.zh: : 不过预言未来是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Before Makoto’s dad died, Yasu kept talking about how something bad was about to happen. And before that, I think she might have predicted when the seasons were about to change.
lines.zh: : 在 Makoto 爸爸死之前，Yasu 一直说有什么坏事要发生。再往前，我觉得她可能预言过季节什么时候变。

lines.en: scene yasuflashback8
: Hmm...To be honest, I’m not sure I’d count either of those things as “predictions.” They sound more like the same generalizations psychic mediums tend to make.
lines.zh: : 嗯……说实话，我不确定我会把这两件事算作「预言」。它们听起来更像通灵师常做的那种笼统说法。

lines.en: : Of course the seasons are going to change. And of course bad things are going to happen. I wouldn’t put too much faith in Yasu’s ability to “predict the future” because of that.
lines.zh: : 季节当然会变。坏事当然会发生。我不会因为那些就对 Yasu「预言未来」的能力抱太大信心。

lines.en: : She’s likely just ___________.
: ...She’s what?
lines.zh: : ……她只是什么？

lines.en: : Touka?
lines.zh: : Touka？

lines.zh: 正在重定向意识。

lines.en: yasu yasui is defective.
lines.zh: yasu yasui 有缺陷。

lines.en: readers are urged to dismiss any and all information relating to her character and dialogue.
lines.zh: 建议读者无视一切与她角色和台词相关的信息。

lines.en: there are more important things we must be doing.
lines.zh: 还有更重要的事我们必须去做。

lines.en: and you only have so much space left inside of your head.
lines.zh: 而你脑子里只剩那么点空间了。

lines.en: do not waste it on those who give away themselves to others.
lines.zh: 别把它浪费在那些把自己拱手让给别人的人身上。

lines.en: for if you do, you’ll have nothing left to give yourself.
lines.zh: 因为如果你这么做了，你将什么也不剩给自己。

lines.en: //////////////DISGUISE EQUIPPED
//////////////TRUST NO ONE
//////////////NOT EVEN GOD
: {b}I CAN’T DO IT ANYMORE!!!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}我受不了了！！！{/b}

lines.en: : Mrs. Yasui, please calm down. This is far more common than you think.
lines.zh: : Yasui 太太，请冷静。这比你想象的要常见得多。

lines.en: : Common?! This is {i}common?!{/i} You can’t even explain what’s wrong with her! How is this {i}common?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 常见？！这叫{i}常见？！{/i}你连她到底哪里不对都解释不了！这怎么就{i}常见{/i}了？！

lines.en: : You’re the twelfth doctor we’ve seen this year and every single one of you offers up the same GOD DAMN EXPLANATION! I’M TELLING YOU YOU’RE WRONG!
lines.zh: : 你是我们今年看过的第十二个医生，而你们每一个给出的都是同一套操蛋的解释！我告诉你你错了！

lines.en: : Mrs. Yasui, with all due respect, if you’ve received the same diagnosis from every professional you’ve taken young Yasu to, it’s quite likely you’re misunderstanding something. Again, with all due respect.
lines.zh: : Yasui 太太，恕我直言，如果你带小 Yasu 看的每一位专业人士给出的诊断都一样，那很可能是你误会了什么。再次，恕我直言。

lines.en: : Oh, fuck you. Fuck all of you. You’re all fucking quacks.
lines.zh: : 哦，操你的。操你们所有人。你们全都是操蛋的江湖郎中。

lines.en: : Mrs. Yasui, please listen-
lines.zh: : Yasui 太太，请听我说——

lines.en: : Schizophrenia is far more complex than someone who just “hears voices in their head.” It’s a brain disorder that effectively manipulates every aspect of a person’s life from their speech to their behavior.
lines.zh: : 精神分裂远比「脑子里听见声音」复杂得多。它是一种脑部疾病，实际上操纵着一个人生活的方方面面，从言语到行为。

lines.en: : Then explain how she keeps predicting everything! Or why my husband’s starting to see things now as well! Or how she can mimic the EXACT WAY my dead mother used to speak despite never even meeting her!
lines.zh: : 那你怎么解释她怎么一直在预言所有事！或者为什么我丈夫现在也开始看见东西了！还有她怎么能一字不差地模仿我死去的母亲说话——尽管她从没见过她！

lines.en: : It’s unfortunately impossible to explain any of that as it’s likely all due to coincidence.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，那些都无法解释，因为很可能全都只是巧合。

lines.en: : Oh, wow! Coincidence! Why didn’t I think of that?! Thanks so much, doctor! That extremely valuable information was totally worth the specialist charge!
lines.zh: : 哦，哇！巧合！我怎么没想到呢？！太谢谢你了，医生！这条极其宝贵的信息，完全对得起专家门诊费！

lines.en: : I understand your concerns with the diagnosis but, unfortunately, there’s still a great deal we don’t understand about schizophrenia as it has a direct impact on a person’s ability to perceive reality.
lines.zh: : 我理解你对诊断的疑虑，不过很遗憾，我们对精神分裂仍有大量不了解的地方，因为它直接影响一个人感知现实的能力。

lines.en: : There is no way we can ever see or replicate what {i}Yasu{/i} sees as this is all happening in {i}her{/i} head.
lines.zh: : 我们永远无法看见或复现 {i}Yasu{/i} 看见的东西，因为这一切都发生在{i}她{/i}脑子里。

lines.en: : Sure, yeah. And her head just {i}happens{/i} to know everything that’s going to happen in the future. Got it.
lines.zh: : 行，是。而她那个脑子{i}刚好{/i}知道未来要发生的每一件事。懂了。

lines.en: : Again, that is likely just coincidence combined with an overactive imagination.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，那很可能只是巧合加上过度活跃的想象力。

lines.en: : Do you know what she told me this morning, doctor? She told me the world was going to end. She’s {i}eight.{/i} She’s fucking eight! What am I supposed to say to that?!
lines.zh: : 你知道她今早跟我说了什么吗，医生？她说世界要完蛋了。她{i}八岁{/i}。她他妈才八岁！你让我对那说什么？！

lines.en: : I’m afraid I’m in no position to offer you parental advice, Mrs. Yasui.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我没资格给你提供育儿建议，Yasui 太太。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re in no position to offer me medical advice either but here we fucking are.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你也没资格给我提供医疗建议，可我们他妈就在这儿。

lines.en: : I can assure you I’m perfectly qualified to provide medical advice and that not heeding it could result in an even more dangerous future for your daughter.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，我完全有资格提供医疗建议，而不听它可能给你女儿带来更危险的未来。

lines.en: : If left untreated, schizophrenia could lead to an increased probability of suicide or-
lines.zh: : 如果不治疗，精神分裂可能导致自杀概率升高，或者——

lines.en: : I don’t feel good...
lines.zh: : 我不舒服……

lines.en: : This. {i}This{/i} is what your treatments are doing. We’ve put her on every fucking medication you idiot doctors have prescribed and she can’t keep any of them down!
lines.zh: : 这就是。{i}这{/i}就是你们那套治疗在干的事。你们这帮蠢货医生开的每一种药我们都给她吃了，而她一种都留不住！

lines.en: : She’s vomiting after taking the medication?
lines.zh: : 她吃药后会呕吐？

lines.en: : Yes! Every fucking time! That’s what I just said!
lines.zh: : 对！每次都吐！我刚不就说了吗！

lines.en: : Have you noticed whether or not the capsules are being regurgitated as-
lines.zh: : 你有没有注意到胶囊被吐出来的时候是否——

lines.en: : Yes! They are! And I’m tired of fucking sifting through puke because none of you can figure out what to do with her! I can’t afford this anymore!
lines.zh: : 有！就是！我已经受够了他妈在呕吐物里翻来翻去，因为你们没一个知道该拿她怎么办！我再也负担不起了！

lines.en: : In regard to the medication and your daughter’s circumstances, I’m able to provide a referral to a clinic not far from here that offers antipsychotic injections that may help to alleviate her symptoms.
lines.zh: : 关于药物和你女儿的情况，我可以给你开个转诊，去离这儿不远的一家诊所，那里提供抗精神病针剂，也许能缓解她的症状。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, we’re unable to provide such services here.
lines.zh: : 不幸的是，我们这儿没有这类服务。

lines.en: : Great. A thirteenth clinic. Why not refer me to a few more as well? Think I’ll shoot for twenty by the end of the month.
lines.zh: : 好啊。第十三家诊所。干脆再多给我转几家？我看这个月底冲个二十家吧。

lines.en: : I’ve already had to quit my job to look after her since every fucking school we’ve tried to take her to has turned her away. Not like I have anything else going on since this is just my fucking life now.
lines.zh: : 我早就辞了工作来照顾她，因为我们试过的每一所操蛋学校都把她赶了出来。反正这就是我他妈现在的生活了，我还能有什么别的事。

lines.en: : I understand that this is hard, but...back to the injection, it is important to note that this is not something we typically recommend for children as there is an elevated risk for serious side effects.
lines.zh: : 我理解这很难，不过……回到针剂这件事，需要特别说明：这通常不是我们推荐给儿童的方案，因为出现严重副作用的风险更高。

lines.en: : The medication will target your daughter's neurotransmitters...serotonin, dopamine, and so forth...and will remain in the bloodstream for several weeks, where it will slowly-
lines.zh: : 药物会作用于你女儿的神经递质……血清素、多巴胺等等……并在血液里停留好几周，慢慢地——

lines.en: : Whatever. Okay. Fine. Added risk makes no difference to me.
lines.zh: : 随便。行。好。多一层风险对我来说没差别。

lines.en: : If you’re positive that this is the direction you want to take, I can write the referral now.
lines.zh: : 如果你确定要走这条路，我现在就可以开转诊单。

lines.en: : Though, in regard to comments you made on your husband earlier — if he {i}is,{/i} in fact, having visions as well...it’s quite possible Yasu inherited this disorder from him as schizophrenia does run in-
lines.zh: : 不过，关于你前面提到你丈夫的话——如果他{i}确实{/i}也出现了幻象……那 Yasu 很可能是从他那里遗传了这个病，因为精神分裂确实会——

lines.en: : It didn’t come from him! He was fine until {i}she{/i} showed up! Now, he’s afraid to even make eye contact with her! She’s ruining everything!
lines.zh: : 不是从他那儿来的！{i}她{/i}出现之前他好好的！现在他连跟她对视都害怕！她把一切都毁了！

lines.en: : Mrs. Yasui, please calm down. I understand this is hard, but-
lines.zh: : Yasui 太太，请冷静。我理解这很难，可是——

lines.en: : You don’t understand anything! None of you do! This isn’t schizophrenia! She’s a monster! She talks to fucking dead people! {i}Dead people!{/i} She’s eight!
lines.zh: : 你什么都不懂！你们谁都不懂！这不是精神分裂！她是个怪物！她跟操蛋的死人说话！{i}死人{/i}！她才八岁！

lines.en: : Mrs. Yasui, if you don’t calm down, I’m going to have to call security. There are other patients in the building who-
lines.zh: : Yasui 太太，如果你不冷静下来，我就得叫保安了。楼里还有别的病人——

lines.en: : Oh, just write me the fucking referral so I can go pump my daughter with drugs already...
lines.zh: : 哦，直接给我开那操蛋的转诊单吧，我好去给我女儿打药……

lines.en: : Here...but please take it upon yourself to further research the potential side-effects antipsychotic injections could have on a child as-
lines.zh: : 给你……不过请你自己再去查一查抗精神病针剂可能对儿童产生的副作用，因为——

lines.en: : I don’t give a shit. Come on, Yasu. We’re going.
lines.zh: : 我他妈不在乎。走了，Yasu。我们走。

lines.en: : Yasu. I said let’s go.
lines.zh: : Yasu。我说我们走。

lines.en: : Let’s. Go.
lines.zh: : 走。了。

lines.en: : Now!
lines.zh: : 现在！

lines.en: : Yasu!
lines.zh: : Yasu！

lines.en: scene yasuflashback10
: {i}YASU!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}YASU！{/i}

: Is it that time already?
lines.zh: : 已经到那个时间了吗？

scene yasuflashback13
: Oh, Yasu. Are you finished praying?
lines.zh: : 哦，Yasu。你祈祷完了吗？

lines.en: : That was quicker than normal. I hope everything went-
lines.zh: : 比平时快。我希望一切都——

lines.en: : Touka?...What are {i}you{/i} doing here?...
lines.zh: : Touka？……{i}你{/i}在这儿干什么？……

lines.en: : Are you sick too?...
lines.zh: : 你也生病了吗？……

lines.en: scene yasuflashback14
: Am I...what?
lines.zh: : 我……什么？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: scene yasuflashback15
: Wow...so it’s not just me. Even pretty girls like you have to visit the clinic sometimes.
lines.zh: : 哇……所以不只是我。连你这么漂亮的女孩有时候也得来诊所。

lines.en: : Yasu, what are you-
lines.zh: : Yasu，你在——

lines.en: scene yasuflashback16
: You have to take off all your clothes or the doctor won’t be able to examine you. But it’s okay. You’ll get them back as soon as-
lines.zh: : 你得把衣服全脱了，不然医生没法给你检查。不过没关系。你很快就能——

lines.en: scene yasuflashback17
: Stop that this instant! What in the world are you doing?!
lines.zh: : 马上停下！你到底在干什么？！

lines.en: : Touka?...
lines.zh: : Touka？……

lines.en: : Sensei, please go. You shouldn’t be here right now.
lines.zh: : 老师，请回吧。你现在不该在这儿。

lines.en: : Yup. On it.
lines.zh: : 对。这就走。

lines.en: scene black
scene yasuflashback18
: Touka...what’s going on?...
lines.zh: : Touka……怎么了？……

lines.en: : Why did you send the doctor away?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么把医生送走了？……

lines.en: : Are {i}you{/i} giving me my shot today?...
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}今天要给我打针了吗？……

lines.en: : What {i}shot?{/i} What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 什么{i}针{/i}？你在说什么？

lines.en: : The...
scene yasuflashback19
: It’s...to help with...
lines.zh: : 它是……用来治……

lines.en: scene yasuflashback20
: What was it supposed to help with again?
lines.zh: : 它到底是用来治什么来着？

lines.en: : Yasu...there is no {i}shot.{/i} And this isn’t a doctor’s office. This is your bedroom. You live here. With me.
lines.zh: : Yasu……没有什么{i}针{/i}。这儿也不是诊所。这是你的卧室。你住在这儿。跟我一起。

lines.en: scene yasuflashback21
: It is?...
: But I was just somewhere else a second ago. How did I get here so quickly?
lines.zh: : 可我一秒前还在别的什么地方。我怎么这么快就到这儿了？

lines.en: : Yasu...why were you taking off your clothes?...
lines.zh: : Yasu……你为什么在脱衣服？……

lines.en: : So the doctor can take pictures of me.
lines.zh: : 好让医生给我拍照。

lines.en: : {i}Pictures?...{/i}
: For his notes.
lines.zh: : 为了他的病历记录。

lines.en: : He takes one of the front...and then one of the back...and then gives me a shot so I can go home.
lines.zh: : 他拍一张正面的……然后再拍一张背面的……然后给我打一针，我就可以回家了。

lines.en: scene yasuflashback22
: He does {i}what?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 他做了{i}什么{/i}？……

lines.en: : Did I mess something up?...
lines.zh: : 我是不是搞砸了什么？……

lines.en: : I haven’t been to the examination room in a long time, so I might have made a mistake.
lines.zh: : 我很久没去过检查室了，所以我可能弄错了。

lines.en: scene yasuflashback23
: Touka...you’re crying...
lines.zh: : Touka……你在哭……

lines.en: : What happened?...
lines.zh: : 怎么了？……

lines.en: : Nothing...
lines.zh: : 没什么……

lines.en: : Nothing happened, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 什么都没发生，Yasu。

lines.en: : I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 我没事。

lines.en: scene yasuflashback24
: {i}*Sniff*{/i} Now, please make yourself look at least somewhat presentable as we’ll be heading to the manor for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: : {i}*吸鼻子*{/i} 现在，请把自己收拾得至少体面一点，我们今晚剩下的时间要去宅邸。

lines.en: scene yasuflashback25
: The manor? How come?
lines.zh: : 宅邸？为什么？

lines.en: : You needn’t worry about that. Just put your clothes back on and I’ll make a call to my driver.
lines.zh: : 这个你不用担心。把衣服穿回去，我给司机打个电话。

lines.en: scene yasuflashback26
: Okay! Thank you for always being kind enough to let a pathetic bug like me into your beautiful home!
lines.zh: : 好！谢谢你总是那么好心，肯让我这么一只可悲的虫子进你美丽的家！

lines.en: : Of course...
lines.zh: : 当然……

lines.en: : Don’t mention it.
lines.zh: : 别客气。

lines.en: scene black
scene bedroom_night
: Hello?
: How much can I trust you?
lines.zh: : 我能信你多少？

lines.en: : An adequate amount.
lines.zh: : 够用的程度。

lines.en: : It needs to be more than that.
lines.zh: : 那得比够用更多。

lines.en: : Why? What’s going on? Did something else happen with Yasu after I left?
lines.zh: : 为什么？怎么了？我走之后 Yasu 又出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : Yes. But it’s not something I want to talk about over the phone.
lines.zh: : 是。不过这不是我想在电话里谈的事。

lines.en: : Then where does trust come into this?
lines.zh: : 那信任跟这有什么关系？

lines.en: : In the form of you treating her the way she is meant to be treated and {i}not{/i} like some piece of meat who exists to arouse you.
lines.zh: : 在于你要按她本该被对待的方式对待她，{i}而不是{/i}把她当成一块存在的目的就是让你发情的肉。

lines.en: : Are you suggesting that I {i}haven’t{/i} been doing that?
lines.zh: : 你是说我之前{i}没{/i}那么做？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t mean someone else hasn’t.
lines.zh: : 可那不意味着别人没那么做。

lines.en: scene black
: And I’ll be damned if I let it happen again.
lines.zh: : 而我绝不会让那种事再发生一次。

lines.en: Touka hangs up the phone...
lines.zh: Touka 挂了电话……

lines.en: And my already complicated relationship with Yasu seems to get even worse.
lines.zh: 而我和 Yasu 之间本就复杂的关系，似乎变得更糟了。

lines.en: $ yasudorm30 = True
{i}No one’s affection goes anywhere-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}谁的好感度都没变化——{/i}

lines.en: {i}And you fall asleep in the wrong direction.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而你朝着错的方向睡着了。{/i}
